pride.note: Yearly. Births per 1,000 people (World Bank SP.DYN.CBRT.IN). Women's share of senior and middle management, % (World Bank SL.EMP.SMGT.FE.ZS, from ILO, patchy years). No dataset counts dates or promotions, so book mentions per million words stand in.

manualAndSport.note: Yearly. Women employed in industry (mining, manufacturing, construction, utilities) as a % of all employed women, ILO modelled estimates via World Bank SL.IND.EMPL.FE.ZS: the closest free series to 'manual jobs'. No free yearly series of women playing sport covers both countries; Sport England's Active Lives (UK, from 2015) is a manual download. Book mentions stand in.

covidHobbies.note: Per country, 2020. Stringency is the Oxford COVID-19 Government Response Tracker index (0-100), via Our World in Data; casesPerMillion2020 is confirmed cases by 31 Dec 2020. Hobby interest is Wikipedia pageviews in that country's main language, % change 2020 vs 2019: a language is not a country (German covers Austria, Spanish covers Latin America), so treat it as a rough stand-in. Google Trends by country would be better and is a manual download.

handsOrCutlery.note: Female population by country, latest year (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL.FE.IN). Divide manicure product imports (UN Comtrade 330430, from Samira's pull) by this for 'per woman'. Includes World Bank regional aggregates, whose ISO3 codes aren't countries (e.g. WLD, EUU). Eating method has no dataset and needs hand coding with a source per country.

MEA.name: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan

MNA.name: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan (excluding high income)

TMN.name: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan (IDA & IBRD)

selfCare.note: Yearly. US jobs in thousands, annual average of monthly, not seasonally adjusted (BLS CES): CEU7071394001 fitness and recreational sports centres, CEU8081211301 nail salons, CEU8081211201 hair salons. No US jobs series for yoga, Pilates, massage or spas alone, so book mentions (per million words, to 2022) and English Wikipedia pageviews (2016-2025) stand in for each.

protests.note: US protests 2017-2020 from the Crowd Counting Consortium (Harvard Dataverse, CC0). 'Women' means the claims mention women, feminism, abortion or reproductive rights, #MeToo or gender equality: a keyword match, not the protesters' gender. bigDays is the 15 dates with the most women's-issue turnout (sum of mean size estimates, events of 10,000+). There is no weekly salon sales series; daily English Wikipedia views of 'Nail salon' stand in, so sum them into weeks for the event study.

byIndustry.note: Lens 3 has no data: nobody publishes who wears nail polish at work. Run a poll (industry + 'do you wear polish at work?'), then weight by women employed per industry: ONS EMP13 (UK, manual download from ons.gov.uk).
